feature.title: Basic end-to-end chunk-index-based optimizer + Add support for `own_chunk` to chunk optimizer
feature.composition: 38a25c277e cherry-picks cleanly onto bef4ed8d92 (no intermediate commit touched re_chunk_optimizer or re_log_encoding); rerun_py changes dropped (not built); Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock changes moved into the base.

oracle.reference: Upstream PR tests (22 + 1) run against the clean-room rebuilt tree, plus 15 authored contract tests (provider/LazyStore integration, error surface, data survival, idempotence, exact band arithmetic) and 49 upstream regression tests of re_chunk_optimizer(analysis), re_log_encoding and re_chunk_store. No gold-output comparison: merged chunks get random ChunkIds and cut points legitimately depend on the accumulation strategy, so the oracle is property-based, not byte-identical.

contamination.notes: Both commits landed in the public repo on 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-09 (4-11 days before task construction); the crate is one week older (analysis-only skeleton from 2026-08-27). Commit messages state the upstream code was largely agent-written and human-reviewed.

derivability.assertion: optimize.rs::end_to_end - four uniform chunks merge into two 4-row outputs <= target; oversized chunk splits into >1 pieces totalling 8 rows; row set preserved
optimize.rs::exact_fill_packs - chunks summing exactly to target pack together (<= fit); output count equals analysis lower bound
optimize.rs::lone_chunk_identity - a lone chunk is emitted as the same Arc and ChunkId
optimize.rs::band_chunk_emits_alone - a chunk in (target, 1.2 target] is not split, emits alone, neighbours emitted alone with identity, in run order
optimize.rs::lazy_loading - no loads at planning; one load per single-chunk run as the stream is polled
optimize.rs::encoding_mismatch - non-concatenable chunks are not merged, no error, identity preserved
optimize.rs::mismatched_blocker_mid_run - a mismatched chunk separates the run; neighbours are never merged across it; three identity outputs in run order
optimize.rs::merge_correctness - merged chunk has a fresh id, RowId-sorted rows, unioned null-padded columns
optimize.rs::unsorted_merge_past_guard_is_refused - unsorted merge over max_rows_if_unsorted is refused (operands sorted, identity); kept when the guard is None
optimize.rs::unsorted_row_guard - unsorted content cuts at max_rows_if_unsorted; sorted guard cuts before merging; both None merges everything; sorted run unaffected by small unsorted guard
optimize.rs::oversized_chunk_splits_mid_run - oversized chunk mid-run is split into fresh pieces, neighbours keep identity and order, rows preserved
optimize.rs::split_tail_coalesces - split pieces re-enter the input sequence; tail piece merges with the following chunk
optimize.rs::unsorted_chunk_splits_on_unsorted_guard - lone unsorted chunk over max_rows_if_unsorted splits [2,2,1]; passes whole when the guard is None
optimize.rs::tiny_chunks_file - 64 tiny chunks via RrdChunkProvider pack to within one of the data floor and beat first-fit over index sizes and over measured sizes
optimize.rs::convergence - re-optimizing the output is a no-op: same count and ChunkId set; outputs inside the band
optimize.rs::own_chunk_separates_columns - a Type rule puts the colors of mixed chunks into a dedicated single-column chunk; cell set preserved
optimize.rs::own_chunk_identity - already-split inputs come out untouched, colors run before the rest run (input order)
optimize.rs::own_chunk_convergence - split output re-optimizes to a no-op; outputs grouped colors then points
optimize.rs::own_chunk_run_target - MergeSplit override rechunks the own column at its own target
optimize.rs::own_chunk_static - a static mixed chunk splits into two static chunks with fresh ids, colors first
optimize.rs::own_chunk_entity_filter - a rule applies to the entities its filter names and no other
optimize.rs::own_chunk_passthrough - merging disabled + rule: each mixed chunk yields exactly its two slices, nothing merges
footers_and_manifests.rs::temporal_map_reads_every_descriptor_variant - typed and untyped variants of one identifier both appear in the temporal map with row count and time range
optimizer_contract.rs::in_memory_provider_basics - manifest rows = chunks, loads return the same Arcs, unknown id errors
optimizer_contract.rs::lazy_store_is_a_chunk_provider - LazyStore usable as Arc<dyn ChunkProvider>; chunks_loaded counts trait loads; rows preserved
optimizer_contract.rs::provider_load_failure_is_reported - Error::LoadChunks with entity and num_chunks
optimizer_contract.rs::provider_omitting_a_chunk_is_reported - Error::MissingChunk naming the absent chunk
optimizer_contract.rs::planning_is_pure - constructing/dropping the stream loads nothing
optimizer_contract.rs::disabled_optimization_passes_everything_through - merge_split None: every chunk emitted once, identity
optimizer_contract.rs::statics_never_merge_or_split - statics whole and identity even when far over the band or sharing an entity
optimizer_contract.rs::chunks_that_do_not_fit_together_emit_alone_in_order - target == size: four identity outputs in order; 2*size: [4,4]
optimizer_contract.rs::oversized_chunk_splits_into_fresh_pieces - pieces have fresh ids, keep rows, are inside the band; second pass does not increase count
optimizer_contract.rs::unsorted_output_never_exceeds_unsorted_guard - no unsorted output over max_rows_if_unsorted; rows preserved
optimizer_contract.rs::own_chunk_type_selector_ignores_untyped_columns - Type matches typed column only; Column matches untyped; no-match leaves identity
optimizer_contract.rs::own_chunk_rules_first_match_wins - rule order decides Passthrough vs merge
optimizer_contract.rs::own_chunk_without_entity_filter_covers_properties_subtree - None filter covers /__properties; EntityPathFilter::all() does not
optimizer_contract.rs::heterogeneous_fixture_survives_and_converges - cell set preserved, own column isolated for the filtered entity, outputs inside band, second pass count <=
optimizer_contract.rs::split_band_helpers_are_exact - 5*size > 6*max_bytes; smallest_non_splitting_target = ceil(5*size/6)
